consumesExternalOutput.provenance: src/commands/init.ts spawns git -C <dir> rev-parse --show-toplevel in the --project arm and PARSES it: <dir> is accepted only when the exit is 0 AND the trimmed stdout resolves to the same real path as <dir>. Red-witness rule (f) therefore binds every witness whose members touch that file. The cited capture is a real run taken 2026-09-24 against git 2.43.0 in a scratch directory, with only that directory's absolute path replaced by <scratch>, and the named test `the captured rev-parse contract init --project parses is reproduced live` re-runs each block and requires the live stdout and exit to equal the recorded ones. The fact that earns its place: a subdirectory of a repository exits 0 and prints the ROOT, so exit status alone would accept it; the stdout comparison is what refuses it.
